comment: ENGINE V2 — macro-first market-cap allocation. Each of the 8 moods is a structurally different market regime at its cycle peak. Chain: total crypto mcap → sector allocation (% of total, per sector) → token share of sector (token config, interpolated by 'intensity') → value-capture factor (token config) → ÷ projected supply at date. SOL: total × solShareRange. Historical peaks are CALIBRATION TESTS (scripts/sanity.ts), not ceilings; fundamentals (revMultipleRange × activityFactorRange) are a plausibility layer, never a cap. totalCryptoMcap ladder anchored to cross-cycle history: prior peaks grew 3.6x (2017→2021) and 1.4x (2021→2025); Base = 1.4x the $4.27T ATH = $6T (the historical MINIMUM inter-cycle growth), Euphoria = 2.8x = $12T (inside the 3.6x precedent). Sector allocation evidence: Solana DeFi app tokens ≈ 0.3% of total crypto at the Jan 2025 peak (~$10.8B of $3.6T), ~0.1% today (depressed); oracle sector ≈ 0.6-0.7% at peak (LINK+PYTH+others ~$22-25B); PUMP alone ≈ 0.08% at its Sep 2025 peak. 'path' = quarterly log-space progress (Q3 2026 → Q4 2029) toward the scenario peak; only Mania/Euphoria model an explicit meaningful post-top drawdown (blow-off character) — other regimes plateau. intensity (0..1) interpolates token share/capture ranges. perp-dex sector is a HYBRID anchor: cold stops price it as the perp-DEX app pool (~0.7% of total today, HYPE ~85%); hot stops price exchange-network convergence — the CEX/DEX line blurring with Hyperliquid as the on-chain exchange + L1 financial network, calibrated against the BNB precedent (BNB held 3.3-5.4% of total crypto realized; euphoria's 1.73% stays ~half BNB's CURRENT share and the implied HYPE mcap stays below BNB's realized $190B peak). mobile-consumer sector added Jul 2026 for SKR: ~0.002% of total today; hot stops widened Jul 2026 for the viral-consumer-breakout case (mania 0.013%, euphoria 0.02%) — still ~8.5x below Helium's ~0.17%-of-total 2021 DePIN precedent.

scenarios.label: Breakdown
scenarios.anchor: no real next cycle — total crypto falls toward $1.5T (0.35x the prior ATH; the 2022-style outcome)
scenarios.description: The cycle fails to materialize. Further weakness, limited recovery.

scenarios.label: Bear case
scenarios.anchor: a shallow bounce to ~$2.5T — barely above today, far below the prior ATH
scenarios.description: Stabilization and restrained improvement — a bounce, not a cycle.

scenarios.label: Weak cycle
scenarios.anchor: the market heals toward ~$3.5T, approaching but not reclaiming the $4.27T ATH
scenarios.description: A real but shallow cycle, well below prior peaks.

scenarios.label: Conservative
scenarios.anchor: a muted cycle that slightly exceeds the prior $4.27T ATH

scenarios.label: Base case
scenarios.anchor: the central next-cycle outcome: ~$6T total = 1.4x the prior ATH — the SMALLEST peak-to-peak growth any crypto cycle has ever delivered (2021→2025)
scenarios.description: A normal cycle: recovery through 2027, expansion after the expected ~Apr 2028 halving, a 2029 top.

scenarios.label: Strong cycle
scenarios.anchor: ~$8T total = 1.9x the prior ATH, comparable to a solid historical cycle
scenarios.description: Faster and higher expansion. Clear new highs everywhere.

scenarios.label: Bull case
scenarios.anchor: ~$10T total = 2.3x the prior ATH — liquidity and narrative dominate fundamentals
scenarios.description: Major multiple expansion beyond ordinary fundamentals; the top wobbles in late 2029.

scenarios.label: Everything aligns
scenarios.anchor: ~$12T total = 2.8x the prior ATH — extreme but inside the 3.6x precedent of 2017→2021; monetary conditions, adoption, regulation and narratives all align
scenarios.description: Global euphoria: everything aligns for the MARKET — each token's own market share and competitive position still apply. The blow-off top breaks down in late 2029.
